message.content: This editorial illustration is set against a dark green gradient background. At the top, the red word "TEMPO" dominates, with text reading "Berebut Kembali Suara Nahdlatul Ulama H.26" and "Transaksi Sepi Bursa Karbon H.78" above it. The words "ENAK" and "PERLU" appear in small red type below. Central text in white reads "DI SINI SUAP, DI SANA SUAP" above a paragraph of Indonesian text regarding "Syahrul Yasin Limpo" and "Firli Bahuri." In the center, a man with a mustache, glasses, and a diamond-patterned vest over a light shirt is depicted mid-stride in the air. He holds a silver badminton racket. Floating around him are several banknotes and a large shuttlecock with a white base and green feathers. In the foreground bottom-right, a hand in a light-colored sleeve holds a red badminton racket. On the bottom-left, the back of a large head and neck is visible. The bottom-left corner contains the date "9-15 OKTOBER 2023", price "RP 50.000", publication details, a barcode, and a QR code.
